instruction: Look up the most recent open issue in "cli/cli" that has the label "bug", then write it in the format "#<number> | <labels> | <title>" to the file "$HOME/Desktop/gh_open_issues_2_4.txt". If there is no issue that matches, save the file as empty.
reference_command: gh issue list --repo cli/cli --state open --search 'label:"bug" sort:created-desc' --limit 1 --json number,title,labels --jq '.[] | "#\(.number) | \(([.labels[].name] | if length == 0 then "none" else join(",") end)) | \(.title)"' > "$HOME/Desktop/gh_open_issues_2_4.txt"
